Author: Infi, Anna
Name: Chat 2 Vanilla
Description:
Fork of Chat 2, modified 2026-11-03.
Original work by Anna (ascclemens) and Infi (Infiziert90), licensed under the EUPL-1.2.
Upstream: https://github.com/Infiziert90/ChatTwo

Chat 2 Vanilla keeps Chat 2's tabs, filters, input, autocomplete, links, and emotes.
A "Vanilla style" option draws the main chat window with the game's own UI textures,
Axis font, channel colors, and log transparency. Turn it off for the original Chat 2 look.

This plugin's internal name is ChatTwoVanilla, so it can be installed next to Chat 2.
Its IPC channels are ChatTwoVanilla.* and do not collide with ChatTwo.*.
Punchline: Chat 2, skinned like the vanilla chat log.
Changelog:
**1.43.3**
- The channel tint fills the dark interior of the input box and stops at the visible rim. The rim is drawn on top of that edge.

**1.43.2**
- The channel tint fills only the center slice of the input frame. The border is drawn on top, so it no longer covers the rim.

**1.43.1**
- Channel tint colors the inside of the input box. The frame stays the normal color.
- A tab's log color is drawn over the dark log texture, so it shows, and it still follows the opacity setting.

**1.43.0**
- Optional channel tint on the vanilla input box, off by default
- Each tab can tint its vanilla log background, saved with the tab
- Log background opacity follows the game, or a 0–100% override
- Vanilla Style settings tab
- Vanilla mode keeps the game's Axis font at the log font size, including pop-outs
- Import the game's four chat tabs, by name and channel filter, after a confirmation

**1.42.1**
- Each chat window keeps its own position and size while the vanilla resize grip is dragged
- Saving settings keeps popped-out tabs popped out
- English settings text uses color, not colour

**Chat 2 Vanilla (fork, 2026-11-03)**
- Toggleable vanilla chat-log style drawn in ImGui from the game's ULD textures
- Renamed to ChatTwoVanilla so it can coexist with Chat 2 (separate commands and IPC)

**Inherited from Chat 2**
- Unlimited tabs, filters, emotes, autocomplete, links, and the web interface
- See the upstream changelog for earlier Chat 2 changes
